notes: Nine localized interaction episodes are identified. The two movable doors of the pantry cabinet are reported separately because both are visibly open by frame 736, although their closely spaced opening and closing moments are partly obscured. Ordinary room-door traversal around frames 1480 onward is not included because a complete visible on/off state episode is not established.
scene_description: A first-person walkthrough of an apartment kitchen, living area, utility closets, laundry alcove, and bedroom. The user sequentially opens and later closes appliance doors, a drawer, several cabinet or closet doors, and bedroom closet doors.
